Dec 10, 2025

Playmakers Cup Delivers a Milestone Weekend in Moorpark With New Innovations

The third annual Playmakers Cup welcomed 96 teams for more than 150 matches and marked the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App, including Follow My Team and Follow My Club.

By Playmaker Sports

The third annual Playmakers Cup brought 96 teams to Moorpark for more than 150 matches over Thanksgiving weekend. Arroyo Vista Park again served as the center of a busy two-day tournament filled with close games, championship moments, and families from across the region.

The weekend also marked the official launch of the Playmaker Sports Tournament App. Follow My Team and Follow My Club gave players, coaches, and families a faster way to keep up with schedules, results, standings, and the teams that mattered most to them.

New event touches continued off the field, with tournament displays, awards, and on-site experiences designed to make the Playmakers Cup feel like more than a standard weekend of games. The goal was to create a tournament players would remember while keeping information easy to find throughout the event.

Playmaker Sports thanks every participating club, coach, referee, volunteer, partner, and family. Their support helped the Playmakers Cup reach another milestone and set the foundation for the next edition.
